title: Snowball vs Avalanche: Pick Your Debt Killer Today

beats.say: Your debt doubles every 3 years at 24% APR.
beats.visual: A stack of dark red overdue bills on a wooden desk under a single harsh lamp, cinematic shadows.

beats.say: That is the Rule of 72 working against you.
beats.visual: A vintage metal desk clock ticking in soft focus, low key moody lighting.

beats.say: If you do not pick a strategy today, you will lose years.
beats.visual: A hand holding a black pen over a blank white ledger page, overhead angle, cinematic grain.

beats.say: Step one. List every debt from highest rate to lowest rate.
beats.visual: Close-up of a hand writing numbers on paper, out of focus background, moody morning light.

beats.say: That is the avalanche method. It saves you the absolute most cash.
beats.visual: A minimalist ceramic coffee cup next to a closed black notebook on a dark table, soft side light.

beats.say: Step two. List every debt from smallest balance to largest balance.
beats.visual: Fingers flipping through pages of a minimalist notebook, dramatic side lighting, rich textures.

beats.say: That is the snowball method. It gives you fast psychological wins.
beats.visual: A single wooden chess piece standing alone on a dark walnut board, moody overhead shot.

beats.say: Step three. Automate minimums on everything, then send every extra dollar to your target.
beats.visual: A dark smartphone resting on a slate desk, screen blurred, cinematic ambient glow.

beats.say: But here is the part nobody mentions. The math favors avalanche.
beats.visual: An old brass desk lamp casting a warm circle of light on an empty wooden desk, moody atmosphere.

beats.say: Paying only the minimum on a $6,000 balance at 24% takes 252 months.
beats.visual: Rain streaks sliding down a large office window at night, city lights blurred in the background.

beats.say: That is 21 years of your life gone to interest payments.
beats.visual: A pendulum swinging slowly in soft shadow, minimalist aesthetic, cinematic contrast.

beats.say: Pick your method right now and stop bleeding your future away.
beats.visual: A closed black leather journal sitting on a dark concrete surface, dramatic edge lighting.

beats.visual: A dark hallway with a single distant light source, cinematic depth, moody tones.

caption: Pick your debt strategy today before interest eats your paycheck alive. #debtfree #personalfinance #moneytips #debtfreejourney
description: Stop letting credit card interest drain your future. Compare the debt avalanche and debt snowball methods and pick your strategy today.
first_comment: Are you picking the avalanche method for math, or the snowball method for wins?
